keyPoints.en: Adjectives usually come before the noun: a tall tree.
keyPoints.hi: विशेषण अक्सर संज्ञा से पहले आता है: a tall tree।

keyPoints.en: They can also come after "is/are": The tree is tall.
keyPoints.hi: "is/are" के बाद भी आ सकता है: The tree is tall।
विशेषण लेखन को रोचक बनाते हैं।

problem.en: Find the adjectives: "Three little kittens slept on a soft mat."
problem.hi: विशेषण ढूँढो: "Three little kittens slept on a soft mat."

steps.en: How many kittens? three. What kind of kittens? little.
steps.hi: कितने kittens? three। कैसे kittens? little।

problem.en: Add an adjective: "I ate a __ mango."

steps.en: Think of how the mango tasted or looked.
steps.hi: सोचो आम का स्वाद या रूप कैसा था।

answer.en: I ate a sweet mango. (juicy, yellow also work)
answer.hi: I ate a sweet mango. (juicy, yellow भी सही)

question.en: Find the adjective: "The old man walked slowly."
question.hi: विशेषण ढूँढो: "The old man walked slowly."

question.en: Find the adjective: "The sky is blue."
Which is an adjective: run, happy, table?
question.hi: कौन-सा विशेषण है: run, happy, table?

intro.en: An adjective describes a noun. It can tell colour (red), size (huge), number (three), shape (round) or quality (brave). "The brave soldier" — brave is the adjective.
intro.hi: विशेषण (adjective) संज्ञा के बारे में बताता है। यह रंग (red), आकार (huge), संख्या (three), रूप (round) या गुण (brave) बता सकता है। "The brave soldier" में brave विशेषण है।
